fact: The Ministry's guidelines for the FY 2026/27 performance contract indicator say the Digitalization of Government Services indicator requires all MCDAs to institutionalize implementation of the Government Enterprise Architecture and Government Interoperability Framework.
title: Guidelines for Implementation of the Digitalization of Government Services Performance Contract Indicator FY 2026/2027 (23rd Cycle)
publisher: Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy, State Department for ICT and the Digital Economy
